target.description:
Target specifies the notification destination in the format required by the consuming implementation.
Examples include email, Slack, a webhook, and Opsgenie.

AlertNotificationTargetSpec.description: AlertNotificationTargetSpec defines an implementation-specific notification destination.

Annotations.description: Annotations maps metadata keys to implementation- or system-specific values.

Label.description: A label value that can be either a single string or an array of strings.

Labels.description: Labels maps each metadata key to a set of values.

displayName.description: DisplayName is the object's human-readable name.

labels.description: Labels contains metadata associated with the object.

annotations.description: Annotations contains implementation- or system-specific metadata.

Metadata.description: Metadata identifies and describes an OpenSLO v1 object.

description: AlertNotificationTarget identifies a destination for SLO alert notifications.
